name: sboot-rehost
description: Firmware rehosting helper for QEMU - ONE continuous chain: the bootloader container is loaded once and every stage after the first is reached by the firmware's own code, through to the kernel mounting rootfs. No -kernel/-dtb/-initrd handoff. Encrypted or absent stages are skipped by redirecting to the next executable stage, and every skip is documented. Runs autonomously (decisions journaled; user prompts and resolutions recorded so a stalled run can be resumed). Static analysis -> stage map -> machine generation -> fault loop -> 3-gate honesty verification (a verification bypass is never silent: it is counted in the verdict). Exynos is the reference family. MediaTek is supported at the guide level only (run guide, knowledge table, arm32 stage derivation, mixed-architecture machine skeleton, eMMC medium): derived from a single device and not yet run end to end by the plugin.
